title: Shortest Unsorted Continuous Subarray
description: Find the shortest continuous subarray that, if sorted, would make the entire array sorted.
pseudocode:
1. min = Infinity, max = -Infinity
2. Find max element where nums[i] < max, set end
3. Find min element where nums[i] > min, set start
4. Return end - start + 1

steps.note: Initialize variables for tracking max and min boundaries.
Traversing forward to find the last element smaller than current max (index 5, value 9).
Traversing backward to find the first element larger than current min (index 1, value 6).
